Dataset Overview

High-level statistics and caption length distribution showing balance and quality.

Key Findings

Finding 1
Short captions (8-12 tokens) dominate the dataset.
Finding 2
Heavy object frequency imbalance — "person" appears in the majority of images.
Finding 3
Gender bias: male-gendered words appear 1.9x more than female-gendered.
Finding 4
Limited linguistic diversity — top 50 content words cover most captions.
Finding 5
~0.2% duplicate captions detected across different images.
Finding 6
Most images are landscape orientation at ~640×427 px.
